metadata.warning: All records except faculty and program display names are fictional demo data. Agriculture BSc, Diploma, and Certificate programs each have 22 synthetic learners with approved marks across their Semester 1 and Semester 2 course units. Do not present generated units, codes, durations, fees, grades, timetables, accounts, or marks as official ECU records.
